title: TaskRevisionManifestCase
description: Shared parity corpus entry. Inputs (files with content) plus the expected canonical contentSha256/fileCount/size, derived independently from the canonical algorithm so both the TypeScript and Python canonicalizers can be red-checked against the same bytes. `expected.contentSha256` is the SHA-256 of the compact canonical JSON (sorted keys, ensure_ascii=false, no whitespace) over schemaVersion + the bytewise-sorted files array.

name.description: Stable identifier; matches the filename stem.

description.description: Which canonicalization rule(s) this case pins.

path.description: Relative path as a caller would report it. May use backslashes; the canonicalizer normalizes to POSIX + NFC.

contentText.description: UTF-8 text content. Mutually exclusive with contentHex.

contentHex.description: Binary content as lowercase hex. Mutually exclusive with contentText.
